plan.title: Select Closed RFQ for Recreate Order

steps.note: Open the Events list where the event state and source can be selected.
Confirm the Events list and its creation control rendered successfully.
Restrict the search to closed or historical events.
Open the first historical event whose card identifies it as an RFQ.
Verify that the selected event is closed rather than live, draft, or withdrawn.
Verify that the closed RFQ has at least one vendor response or bid.
